notes.title: Free Playtest for Classic Card Games 3D (Version 1.5.8)
notes.notes:
A playtest for version 1.5.8 of Classic Card Games 3D is now available. This beta version introduces new rule options:


 Blackjack: Splitting hands is now possible.
 Rummy: Multiple sets or sequences can be combined during the initial meld to meet the minimum point 
requirement. Additionally, card values, number of cards, and other rules can be customized.
The playtest will be open for a few days and offers a preview of the major update planned for Q1 2025.
